description: Read one job's current status. Use after hydracept_submit_job or hydracept_run with wait=false; use hydracept_get_receipt after success. hydracept_job_inspect (POST /mcp/full) and hydracept_jobs_find (POST /mcp/full) are on the full profile (/mcp/full). Requires bearer key. No charge. Returns: HydraceptJob status projection for the jobId. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUND.

job_id.description: Required job id from hydracept_run or hydracept_submit_job.
job_id.title: Job Id

name: hydracept_job_status
title: Read job status
